battle_start.text: Breathe slowly. This will be over soon.
battle_start.direction: a physician's bedside manner, very tired

battle_start.text: I'm sorry. You're standing between me and the only thing I have left.
Please don't make me do this. I've so little time left for anything else.

hit.text: Hold still. It's worse if you move.
There. Clean. You'll want that bound.

miss.text: Hm. You're quicker than you look.

crit.text: Just under the ribs. I always did know where to cut.

kill.text: Time of death. No. I don't keep count any more.

ally_down.text: They don't feel it. I checked. I checked so carefully.

low_hp.text: I'm fine. Physicians are the worst patients.

victory.text: Go down the mountain. Get warm. Forget you came here.

defeat.text: Wait. Please. My notes. Don't burn my notes.
Then it was for nothing. All of it, for nothing.
